resources.string: Make staff calls using your PrimeCare account. The calling portal opens in Chrome with your existing sign-in and permissions.

1. Tap Open calling portal and sign in.
2. Open Calls → Call a client’s phone.
3. Enter the number with its country code and tap Call phone.
4. Allow the microphone, then use Mute or End phone call as needed.
Keep the calling portal open during the call. This test APK does not provide background calling, a locked-screen call service, or incoming-call notifications.
Install or enable Google Chrome, then tap Open calling portal again.
